text:
We confirmed today that Peverell Semiconductors cut 1,200 staff in a restructuring announced at its glass-floored Merrow Park campus. Management told us the reductions affect fabrication, test, and back-office teams, with most departures concentrated in the 300 mm line and the packaging unit. The company said the move follows weaker demand in industrial controllers and a delayed upgrade to its vector memory process. We reviewed the internal notice and the severance schedule, which includes 10 weeks’ pay and extended health coverage through March.

- Total layoffs: 1,200
- Announced: 14 October
- Main sites affected: Merrow Park and South Quay Test Hall
- Leadership cited: lower orders, delayed capex, and margin pressure
